title: OTel service name is producer controlled

source_refs.statement: Uses service.name from the span resource.

security_impact: Producer can claim another application's namespace.
reproduction_steps: Ingest two distinct trace contexts carrying the same arbitrary service.name.
expected_finding_if_exploited: Both traces are stored under the asserted application name.
affected_scope: OTel ingest and application-filtered trace queries
recommended_mitigation: Bind producer identity to an allowlisted application name.
false_positive_considerations: Deployment-level trusted resource configuration may constrain producers.

title: Trace upsert permits application ownership takeover
preconditions: Writer can submit an existing trace_id

source_refs.statement: Trace save replaces existing trace fields and span set.

data_flow: Incoming trace id and application name to conflict update
security_impact: A writer can reassign attribution and prune existing spans.
reproduction_steps: Save trace then submit same trace_id with another application_name and fewer spans.
expected_finding_if_exploited: Existing owner and span set are replaced.
recommended_mitigation: Enforce ownership on update or authenticate repository writers.
false_positive_considerations: Replacement is documented API behavior for trusted callers.

title: Native tracer retains spans without a bound
data_flow: Each decorated call appends a Span retained in process memory
security_impact: Memory use grows with lifetime call count.
reproduction_steps: Run repeated decorated calls without clear and inspect _spans length.
recommended_mitigation: Clear trace-local buffers after export or impose a bound.
false_positive_considerations: Applications may explicitly clear tracers today.

title: Cohen d accepts singleton samples and returns NaN
preconditions: Either score sample has one observation
data_flow: Singleton input to sample std to NaN output
security_impact: Invalid statistical result may propagate into regression decisions.
reproduction_steps: Call cohens_d with one score on each side.
recommended_mitigation: Require at least two observations or return explicit sentinel.
false_positive_considerations: Callers may enforce sample sizes upstream.

title: LLM judge silently clamps invalid scores
preconditions: Completion function returns NaN or score above one

source_refs.statement: Raw score is clamped without validating LLMJudgeResponse.

data_flow: Untrusted completion JSON to float score then clamp
security_impact: Malformed model output can become a perfect metric score.
reproduction_steps: Return JSON scores NaN and 150 from completion_fn.
expected_finding_if_exploited: NaN propagates or 150 is clamped to 1.0 without warning.
recommended_mitigation: Validate parsed data with LLMJudgeResponse and fail closed on invalid score.
false_positive_considerations: Clamping may have been intended to tolerate model variation.

title: Collector queue is unbounded
preconditions: Producers enqueue faster than repository persistence
data_flow: Incoming traces accumulate while worker lags
security_impact: Sustained load can exhaust process memory.
reproduction_steps: Inspect queue.maxsize on a new collector.
recommended_mitigation: Configure finite queue capacity and backpressure behavior.
false_positive_considerations: Deployment may externally limit producer rate.

title: CRLF log injection is not escaped
preconditions: Untrusted text is included in a log message

source_refs.statement: Formats getMessage output without sanitizing carriage returns or line feeds.

data_flow: Caller text to LogRecord message to formatted stream
security_impact: Forged log lines can mislead operators and log parsers.
reproduction_steps: Log a message containing CRLF and inspect formatted output.
expected_finding_if_exploited: Literal CRLF appears in the output.
recommended_mitigation: Escape CR and LF in message text before formatting.
false_positive_considerations: Some multiline diagnostic logs may be intentional.
